reasoning_notes: For each candidate I mapped every event to its causal chain (7 chains given), kept only the single best chain per candidate, and scored the longest subsequence of that chain's events whose first_seen_day order matches the chain's causal position order. Primary discriminators, in order of weight: (1) chain purity - how many of the candidate's links sit on ONE chain vs scattered across unrelated chains (C-16 with 7 links spanning 5 different chains is the archetypal artefact, likewise C-9 whose six chain-1 events all fire within days 1-5 in scrambled causal order); (2) causal ordering - strict monotonic first_seen_day along chain position, with a real time lag between links; violations demoted hard (C-4 regulatory_notice before audit_finding, C-38 forecast_revision before margin_compression, C-43 unplanned_downtime before sensor_drift, C-22 checkout_drop before api_error_spike, C-11 yield_drop before component_defect); (3) per-link independent corroboration - every link in the sequence needs independent_sources >= 2-3 spread over >= 2 distinct_sites and ideally >= 2 distinct_regions. A chain whose links rest on independent_sources == 1 is not a chain no matter how long (C-3, C-37, C-45, C-21, C-30, C-47, and the single-source tails of C-0, C-2, C-19, C-29, C-41). (4) Loud-site suppression: high total_reports relative to independent_sources combined with low distinct_sites/distinct_regions reads as one site's routine traffic rather than cross-organisational signal - this held back C-33 (five perfectly ordered chain-1 links but nearly all inside a single region), C-35, C-54's firmware link and C-52's attrition/sla links. Chain length alone was explicitly NOT rewarded: n_links and distinct_sites_total correlate with noise volume, and several 5-7 link candidates rank near the bottom. The 17 I put forward all show >= 3 links on one chain, strictly in causal order with meaningful lags, each link carried by >= 2 (usually 3-9) independent sources across multiple sites and regions; C-26 (cobalt, chain 1 supplier_substitution -> component_defect -> yield_drop -> customer_escalation, 5-9 sources per link across 5 regions) and C-12 (granite-core, chain 4 attrition -> backlog -> sla_breach -> account_churn) are the cleanest. Contradiction counts were low everywhere and only used as a mild tiebreak.
